﻿# Fix Maven Compilation Failure: sonarlint-core 8.15.0.65216 -> 9.1.1.74346

## Context

Project `sorald` (by ASSERT-KTH) has a **COMPILATION_FAILURE** after a dependency upgrade bot bumped
`org.sonarsource.sonarlint.core:sonarlint-core` from `8.15.0.65216` to `9.1.1.74346` (other update).

Reference PR: https://github.com/ASSERT-KTH/sorald/pull/1065

## Your Task

The source code is in `/sorald`. Fix all compilation errors so that `mvn compile` succeeds.
I'll analyze the compilation failure and fix it. Let me start by understanding the project structure and the compilation errors.

                <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.1.2</version>

                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>

                </configuration>
            </plugin>
        </plugins>
    </build>

    <profiles>
        <profile>
            <id>spoonSnapshot</id>
            <repositories>
                <repository>
                    <id>ow2.org-snapshot</id>
                    <name>Maven Repository for Spoon Snapshots</name>
                    <url>https://repository.ow2.org/nexus/content/repositories/snapshots/</url>

        <developerConnection>scm:git:ssh://github.com/SpoonLabs/sorald.git</developerConnection>
        <url>https://github.com/SpoonLabs/sorald</url>
        <tag>HEAD</tag>
    </scm>

steps.message:
The build is now successful. The fix was straightforward - the `addEnabledLanguages()` method was removed from `AnalysisEngineConfiguration.Builder` in sonarlint-core version 9.x, so I simply removed that line from the `buildAnalysisEngineConfiguration()` method.

**Summary of the fix:**

In `/sorald/sorald/src/main/java/sorald/sonar/SonarLintEngine.java`, I removed the `.addEnabledLanguages(globalConfig.getEnabledLanguages())` call from the `buildAnalysisEngineConfiguration()` method (line 163). This method was removed in sonarlint-core 9.x as the API has been refactored - language configuration is now handled differently through the `PluginsLoader.Configuration` class.
